parameter lambda = 16'h00C7; // forgetting factor for RLS algorithm (scaled)

reg signed [15:0] p [0:n-1]; // inverse correlation matrix
reg signed [15:0] k [0:n-1]; // Kalman gain vector
reg signed [15:0] x_delayed [0:n-1]; // delayed input signals
reg signed [15:0] w_new [0:n-1]; // new filter coefficients

initial begin
  for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
    taps[i] = 0;
    p[i] = 0; // Initialize inverse correlation matrix to zero
  end
end

// compute delayed input signals

  if (rst) begin
    for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
      x_delayed[i] = 0; // reset delayed values on rst
    end

end

  if (rst) begin
    for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
      w_new[i] = taps[i]; // Maintain the current taps on reset
    end
  end else begin
    for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
      w_new[i] = taps[i] + (mu * e * x_delayed[i]) >>> 15; // Scale mu for proper fixed-point multiplication
    end
    for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin

end

    for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
      k[i] = 0; // reset Kalman gains on rst
